title: Effectiveness of COSMIC as Platform for Financial Institutions to Share Information on Customers Showing Money Laundering Red Flags
what_it_is: Effectiveness of COSMIC as Platform for Financial Institutions to Share Information on Customers Showing Money Laundering Red Flags

sections.label: COSMIC launch and financial crime risks
sections.summary: COSMIC's initial phase involved six major Singapore banks and targeted misuse of legal persons, trade finance misuse, and proliferation financing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: COSMIC's initial phase involved six major commercial banks in Singapore, and targeted three key financial crime risks: (a) misuse of legal persons; (b) misuse of trade finance for illicit purposes; and (c) proliferation financing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Since its launch, COSMIC has enhanced participant banks' ability to detect bad actors and strengthened our financial sector's defences against financial crime.

sections.label: COSMIC expansion after FATF assessment
sections.summary: MAS is widening COSMIC's scope beyond three risk areas and onboarding more banks, with expansion scheduled for completion within two years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: COSMIC's effectiveness was affirmed in the recent Mutual Evaluation assessment of Singapore by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Given these positive outcomes, MAS has been working with the industry to expand the use of COSMIC.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: We are widening COSMIC's scope beyond the three targeted financial crime risk areas that I have mentioned above, and we are also onboarding other major banks that are close partners in our Anti-Money Laundering, Countering the Financing of Terrorism efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: This expansion is scheduled for completion within two years.

sections.label: COSMIC first-year STR outcomes
sections.summary: In its first year, participant banks filed additional STRs on fund flows over $1.6 billion and closed more than 1,000 suspicious accounts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In the first year of operations, COSMIC participant banks filed additional Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) relating to aggregate fund flows of more than $1.6 billion dollars.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And following the participant banks' review and investigation, more than1,000 suspicious customer accounts were closed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, we are reviewing the efficacy and effectiveness of COSMIC, and the mutual evaluation by the FATF also gives us some feedback on whether this is effective.
